Walk-Through Metal Detector FC-C (Deluxe)

Detection Zones: 12 overlapping mesh zones
Overall Dimensions: 2200(H) x 840(W) x 475(D) mm
High-precision security screening for airports, stations, and government buildings; 12-zone independent alarm display; adjustable 1000-level sensitivity; robust anti-interference and vibration resistance.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC-C metal detection gate is a specialized security device designed to detect whether personnel are carrying metallic objects. Widely known as a walk-through metal detector, it is extensively deployed in prisons, courts, museums, libraries, hospitals, schools, electronic factories, ports, and high-speed rail stations. It is also an essential screening tool for concert venues and large conferences, effectively identifying hidden dangerous items such as firearms and controlled knives to ensure the highest level of public safety in high-traffic environments.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • Multi-zone precision detection: 18 independent overlapping detection zones covering full body from head to toe.
  • High sensitivity: detects very small metal items including paper clips, pins, and coins.
  • Anti-interference technology: proprietary DSP digital filtering for stable operation near other electronic equipment.
  • Bi-directional counter: automatically counts and displays the number of people passed and alarms triggered.
  • Password protection: multi-level password system prevents unauthorized parameter changes.
  • Remote operation: supports wireless keyboard/mouse for convenient parameter adjustment.
  • 360° LED indicators: LED light bars on all four pillars visually indicate the exact alarm zone.
  • Audio-visual alarms: adjustable volume, multiple alarm tones, and synchronized LED flash alerts.
  • Self-diagnostic function: automatic self-test at startup with fault indication.
  • Weatherproof design: suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
  • Technical Standards: Strictly complies with GB15210-2018 national standard for walk-through metal detection gates.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Detection Zones12 independent overlapping zones with multi-target display
Sensitivity Range0-1000 adjustable levels; detects items as small as a paperclip
Anti-interference1000-level DSP digital filtering for superior electromagnetic compatibility
ConstructionABS housing with aluminum alloy supports and waterproof/flame-retardant panels
IntelligenceMicrocomputer-controlled automatic traffic and alarm counting
Health SafetyWeak magnetic field technology; safe for pacemakers and pregnant women
Tactical Deployment12 frequencies; supports side-by-side use (35mm interval)
WeightApprox. 45kg
Power Consumption<35W
Frequency AdjustmentInfinitely adjustable based on installation environment
Passage Dimensions2000(H) x 710(W) x 400(D) mm
